user_decision.prompt_context: direct response to the explicit request to send DP-VQ10=A to proceed
user_decision.label: Card-attached always-visible Newly/Undo status rail

surface.actual_card: retain the existing NodeCard/BitCard selection, navigation, padding, radius, base color, and internal content unchanged
surface.newly_marker: static source-backed marker at the actual card leading corner
surface.undo_action: separate stable trailing action slot that never bubbles into card navigation
surface.status_rail: one compact always-visible rail immediately below the actual card inside the same Explorer item wrapper
prohibited: common-card internal, layout, or eight-theme redesign
current main-card menu or generic disabled-button fallback
toast, dialog, detached panel, disclosure-only, tooltip-only, or hover-only reason
prototype repeated pulse, blink, ping, flicker, or glow loop
theme-ID product behavior or copy branch

independent_state.selection: existing selected treatment and focus ring remain authoritative
independent_state.newly: marker provenance remains present through selection and Undo ineligibility until mounted-page lifetime ends
independent_state.eligibility: changes only the stable action and rail state; never clears marker, selection, coordinates, order, or ordinary navigation
independent_state.unavailable_action: Undo remains keyboard-focusable with aria-disabled=true, suppresses mutation, and references the visible reason

eligibility_copy.result_mutated: This item changed after placement. Undo is unavailable.
eligibility_copy.descendants: Undo newly placed items below this one first.
eligibility_copy.placement_open: Finish or cancel the placement in progress first.
eligibility_copy.operation_locked: Wait for the current action to finish.
eligibility_copy.edit_blocked: Save or cancel the current edit before undoing.
eligibility_copy.conflict: This item or its source changed. Undo is unavailable.

operation_copy.unknown: We couldn’t confirm whether “{title}” was undone.

result_mapping.applied_or_already_applied: announce restoration once, then remove only the committed result card
result_mapping.not_applied: retain result/source/marker, expose Retry, reuse the logical operation ID, and return to pending
result_mapping.unknown: retain operation identity and expose read-only Check again without resend
result_mapping.rejected_or_conflict: use the narrow returned eligibility reason or the canonical conflict copy; expose no Retry, cascade, overwrite, or compensation
result_mapping.optimistic_change: forbidden; actual result, source truth, marker, and rail remain until authoritative success

focus_and_lifetime.pending: retain the stable Undo action position
focus_and_lifetime.conflict: focus the keyboard-focusable unavailable Undo slot with its visible reason
focus_and_lifetime.ordinary_success: focus next card, then previous card, then column heading; announce restored source without cross-section focus or scroll
focus_and_lifetime.search_success: Task 158 alone composes the approved next-result then search-input handoff
focus_and_lifetime.marker: preserve across Scratch, path, theme, and light-dark changes; clear on Inbox route exit, reload, or unmount
focus_and_lifetime.reenabled: announce once and persist until Undo, another eligibility change, next activation of that card, or route exit/reload; no timer
focus_and_lifetime.status: announce each changed visible rail sentence once through a polite atomic status, never per rerender

motion.ordinary: marker, rail, action, state, result removal, and focus changes are immediate and static
motion.prohibited: fade, slide, scale, skeleton, shimmer, spinner, progress loop, pulse, ping, bounce, blink, flicker, and layout-transition animation
motion.reduced_motion: identical geometry, copy, controls, focus, timing, and lifetime

theme_mapping.griddo: static sky dot and technical NEW; ruled rail and separate canonical Undo
theme_mapping.tiny-desk: static yellow paper edge and amber pin; stationery note rail and brown Undo
theme_mapping.neumorphism: static violet-blue dot and NEW capsule; inset reason trough and raised Undo without pulse
theme_mapping.claymorphism: static sky badge; sculpted reason ribbon and tactile rose Undo
theme_mapping.origami: static folded-corner marker; seam-attached rail and rose Undo with no animated fold
theme_mapping.terminal: textual [new]; variable-driven [UNDO] and one-line status record with no blink or glow loop
theme_mapping.retro-mac: static 1-bit [NEW]; hard Undo and in-item system line preserving selected inversion
theme_mapping.graphite: restrained black NEW; strengthened-rule caption and labeled Undo with precise focus

implementation_boundary.excludes: product implementation in Task 117, common-card redesign, starting Tasks 155–156 or 158, DP-VQ11 or Task 118 authority, command/repository changes, prototype fallback, and theme-ID logic

exact_release.consumption_condition: Task 117 user checkpoint accepted; its plan marker remains open until then
exact_release.all_other_tasks: unreleased; Tasks 155–156 remain separately planned prerequisites, Task 158 remains unreleased by this receipt, and Task 118 remains unstarted
